title: Name a group of steps
summary: COBOL: Name a group of steps. Change the paragraph message.
introduction: A paragraph labels a group of steps. PERFORM runs that paragraph and returns.
learningObjectives: Name a group of steps with COBOL

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.

blocks.title: Name a group of steps
blocks.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
procedure division.
PERFORM GREET
STOP RUN.
GREET.
DISPLAY "Hello again".

blocks.text: PERFORM enters GREET and returns afterward. STOP RUN prevents later fall-through.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: STOP RUN before paragraph definitions prevents accidental fall-through at the end.
